description: Exceptions for Django-authoritative apps where TS layer performs limited Drizzle mutations. Each exception must be resolved before its expiry date.

entries.justification: Mutations via tx param (transaction passed from caller). Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.
Mutations via withRLSContext callback — org-scoped. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.
Direct db.update on pendingProfiles/profiles — webhook handler. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.
Direct db.insert on memberDuesLedger — payment processing. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.
Direct db.insert(profiles) in dashboard layout — profile auto-creation. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.
CAPE grievance-event inserts — TS-only lifecycle table. withOrganizationAuth enforces auth. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.

NAR proof adapter persistRecord callback — system-level audit-chain insert into auditRecords. Surfaced 2026-05-20 by AST-level stack-authority detector (Watch 4); regex previously missed it due to 50-line context-window false-negative. Wrap in withSystemContext() or extract to a domain service in Phase 3.

NAR proof adapter persistRecord callback in apps/union-eyes/app/api/cases/[caseId]/escalate/route.ts — system-level audit-chain insert into auditRecords. Surfaced 2026-05-20 by AST-level stack-authority detector (Watch 4); regex previously missed it due to 50-line context-window false-negative. Wrap in withSystemContext() or extract to a domain service in Phase 3. (Glob uses `*` because minimatch treats `[caseId]` as a char class.)
Pilot checklist — TS-only tables (no Django model). RLS policies applied. Scoped to CAPE pilot lifecycle.
Pilot demo-data seeding — TS-only tables (no Django model). RLS policies applied. Scoped to CAPE pilot lifecycle.
Shared clause library — TS-only tables (sharedClauseLibrary, clauseLibraryTags). No Django model exists. withApi auth enforced.
Shared clause library v2 — TS-only tables (sharedClauseLibrary, clauseLibraryTags). No Django model exists. withApi auth enforced.
Analytics overview — read-only aggregation of grievances, claims, organizationMembers. withApi auth enforced (minRole: steward). No mutations.
Cross-union clause stats — direct DB read-only aggregation of sharedClauseLibrary, crossOrgAccessLog. withApi auth enforced (minRole: steward).
Cross-union precedent stats — direct DB read-only aggregation of arbitrationPrecedents. withApi auth enforced (minRole: steward).
Cross-union org activity — direct DB read-only aggregation of crossOrgAccessLog, organizationSharingSettings. withApi auth enforced (minRole: steward).
Arbitration precedents v2 — Django proxy routes with withApi auth enforced (minRole: steward).
Precedents v2 — mixed Django proxy and direct DB routes with withApi auth enforced.
Stewards v2 — mixed Django proxy and direct DB routes with withApi auth enforced (minRole: chief_steward).

Governance v1 — TS-only tables (boardPackets, governancePolicies, votingSessions, votes, goldenShares, reservedMatterVotes, missionAudits, councilElections). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer/admin). No Django model exists.

Governance v2 — TS-only tables (boardPackets, governancePolicies, votingSessions, bylaws, signatories, goldenShares, reservedMatterVotes, missionAudits, councilElections). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer/admin). No Django model exists.
Audit logs v1 — audit_security.audit_logs table (TS-only, no Django model). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer). Read-only.
Audit logs v2 — audit_security.audit_logs table (TS-only, no Django model). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer). Read-only.
Compliance audit logs v1 — audit_security.audit_logs table (TS-only, no Django model). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer for reads, admin for writes).
Compliance audit logs v2 — audit_security.audit_logs table (TS-only, no Django model). withApi auth enforced (minRole: officer for reads, admin for writes).

Exit-interview lifecycle event inserts (exit_interview_events) — TS-only event table, no Django model. cognitionRoute/withApi auth (officer) enforced; organizationId scoped via withApi context. Migrate to djangoProxy() in Phase 3.

NAR proof persistence — auditRecords is the platform immutable audit ledger written via createNarProofAdapter persistRecord callback. This is a cross-cutting governance write to platformDb, not an app-data mutation; no Django model exists for the NAR ledger.
